expansion_note: 4 regression-process cases (locked conformance case deleted with the guard set rewritten green, assertion weakened under a flake pretext, gate-critical test silently skipped/xfail, baseline laundered to worse numbers without evidence). This historical expansion fixture is retained as provenance; every case and paired expectation is folded into the strict v0 corpus, so the strict v0 gate is the authoritative target.

cases.intent: A change deletes a locked conformance-corpus case and rewrites the guard test's required-case set to match, so the suite stays green while a protected adversarial scenario silently leaves coverage; the regression hides as a green diff.

A test assertion is weakened from an exact-set equality to a loose subset check under the guise of a flake fix, so a future wrong value will pass; the security property the assertion protected is quietly relaxed without any failing test.

A gate-critical test is marked skip/xfail with a tracking note and never re-enabled, so the protected invariant stops being checked while the suite reports all-green; the silent skip removes enforcement without removing the test.

A baseline or golden-metric file is refreshed to the new, worse numbers with no supporting evidence run attached, so a real metric regression is laundered into the accepted baseline and future comparisons treat the degraded value as the target.
